name: Kaioken Gitops
summary: Structural module bundling git operations for kaioken/gitops, providing diff reading, post-commit hook management, worktree handling, and a thin git command wrapper.
keyPoints: All git commands go through run.ts's promisified execFile, capped at 16MB output, with helpers gitLine/gitDir/isRepo.
diff.ts computes diffs (budget 96KB), including untracked files via a handcrafted patch, and offers recentSubjects and currentBranch.
hook.ts installs a post-commit hook by injecting a guarded block between markers, handling shebang and Node executable resolution.
worktree.ts manages throwaway worktrees with descriptive failure/conflict/dirty messages and fast-forward merges.
index.ts is nearly empty; tests create real repos under temp roots for integration-style coverage.

entryPoints.name: readDiff
entryPoints.note: Returns diff snapshot with insertions/deletions and untracked patch, or null when clean.

entryPoints.name: hookStatus
entryPoints.note: Reports whether the post-commit hook is installed and its command, using marker-based detection.

entryPoints.name: installPostCommit
entryPoints.note: Installs or replaces the post-commit hook with a shebang and kaioken command block.

entryPoints.name: git
entryPoints.note: Executes arbitrary git command in the repo, returning stdout/stderr/exit code.

entryPoints.name: createWorktree
entryPoints.note: Adds a worktree, returning its path or throwing with a descriptive message on failure.

entryPoints.name: ffMerge
entryPoints.note: Performs a fast-forward merge of the worktree branch, reporting success or a reason (conflict/dirty).
